name: Qube Browser 0.5.1
notes:
0.5.1
Fixed:
* Updates no longer fail right after you press Update

0.5.0
New:
* Notes: text notes and whiteboards, as tabs and in the Library
* Command bar with 60 commands, and Ask AI
* Qube Spark: chat with Claude or ChatGPT
* Streaming Space: a Space with a tile per streaming service
* Little Qube: links from other apps open in a small window
* Spotify as music source, next to Apple Music
* Per profile: search engine, download folder and extensions
* Full keyboard and Narrator support
* Settings in the Windows 11 style
* Works on PCs without a graphics card, such as Windows 365 Cloud PCs

Improved:
* Tabs not used for an hour are unloaded to save memory
* Windows from your last session reopen at start

Fixed:
* Permission questions and page dialogs no longer get lost
* A tab moved to another Space right after opening keeps its page
summary: Notes, a new command bar, a Streaming Space, and support for PCs without a graphics card.

mac.name: Qube for Mac 0.10.0
mac.notes:
New:

* The ad blocker works on every page again, built in as Arc's: Block Ads, Block Trackers and Block Cookie Banners in Settings, and Ad Block Settings… to pick uBlock Origin Lite's lists yourself
* Interface Scale in Settings › General: Qube's own controls from 75 % to 150 %
* Default Page Zoom for every page
* Capture puts a part of a page on a Note's board (Add to Note, or ⇧⌘2), and the board keeps the page's link
* A web address pasted on a board becomes a link card; a board can be exported as a picture and given its own thumbnail in the Library
* Clicking with the scroll wheel scrolls the page by moving the mouse, as on Windows
* Plex as a streaming service

Changed:

* Pages run on Chromium 155
* Peek opens out of the link you clicked and loads while it opens; Replace drops the page into place
* Settings looks like macOS's own, and opens smaller
* The selected tab's highlight fades instead of jumping
* The streaming glow uses far less of the graphics chip

Fixed:

* A link that opens a new tab from inside a Peek opens a new tab, instead of reopening the Peek
* Library › Notes shows your notes again
* A folder's page count is no longer cut off on the right
mac.summary: Chromium 155, an ad blocker that works on every page, Settings you can scale, and Peek rebuilt from the ground up.
